summary: Entravision Communications filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events, announcing the appointment of Michael Christenson as Chair of the Board, effective July 16, 2026, while he continues as CEO. Paul Zevnik resigned as Chair but remains lead independent director. This is a routine board leadership change with no forced departure, activist campaign, or structural transaction. No deal terms, premium, or financial implications are disclosed. This filing does not represent a special situation under the defined categories.
